notes: Skills ecosystem - car 4 of the autonomous-operations design: an official, review-gated skill catalog that starts private and reaches the website. Repository: github.com/aidog-im/aidog-skills created PRIVATE under the standing confidentiality ruling, laid out per the design's catalog spec - catalog.json at the root (slug/name/category/description/version/requires/install_status), skills organized by six categories, a deterministic lint gate, a four-step human REVIEW gate, and a THIRD_PARTY attribution file. First batch of twelve skills: the five in-repo skills verbatim, six desensitized recreations mined read-only from the sister project (identity/persona skills excluded by policy; every recreation stripped of machine paths, personal fields, handles, credentials and internal codenames), and one upstream skill carried with its Apache-2.0 license and attribution. The new repository's own lint passes 300/300 with zero leak hits across all 25 files. Website: a new bilingual /skills.html directory page in the Draft E visual language reads the committed catalog copy, the home page's skills shelf now points at it, sitemap and llms.txt gained their entries, and the site pack grows 217 to 254 keys. API: GET /api/skills/remote serves the catalog fail-soft - remote fetch with a 5s timeout and 60s cache, falling back to the bundled copy (source:cache) and finally to an honest 200 {source:unavailable} (never a 5xx), unauthenticated read-only, unknown keys projected away. Verification: tmp/e2e_skills_catalog.py 167/167 (schema, leak scan, bilingual render, 12 entries, six categories, zero overflow at 1440/390, zero page errors, site gates 62 and 59 still green) and tmp/e2e_skills_remote.py 37/37 (remote success, real 5s timeout plus cache reuse against a request-swallowing stub, both sources down still 200, non-catalog fallback, production byte identity). Gates after this car: core 1477/1477, console smoke 234/234, router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup 99/99, profile 63/63, desktop 15/15, source lint 0/67 + packs 614/614 (console untouched), publish gate READY(0), the 17-leg E2E series green (adds skills catalog 167 and skills remote 37), site gates 62 + 59, screenshots 7/7; docs/features/skills_ecosystem.md is capability document 33; site pack 254 keys.
